frictions.description: CLI test runner (integrate.cli.test.js) exits with code 1 on PowerShell because stderr warnings from plan.json/verify.json missing are treated as errors by PowerShell, even though all tests pass. This does not indicate a real failure.
frictions.resolution: Verified all 15 test lines show PASS; exit code 1 is a PowerShell stderr-handling artifact, not a test failure.

summary: Tested 4 assertions: all 4 passed. VAL-CLI-004 confirmed via CLI tests (15/15 PASS) and source code inspection showing integrate.json write path. VAL-CROSS-001 confirmed via report tests (23/23 PASS) and source inspection showing integration-report.md write path. VAL-CROSS-002 confirmed: loadModelConfig+callModel imported from model-connector, executeWorkstream NOT present.
